mapper.sql: select id, site_code, name, description, range_code, metrics, send_hour, receivers, enabled, ai_enabled, ai_model, snapshot_enabled, snapshot_query, last_slot, last_run_at, last_status, last_error, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from dashboard_subscription
mapper.select: where del_flag = '0' and upper(site_code) = upper(#{siteCode}) and enabled = #{enabled} order by site_code, id
where del_flag = '0' and enabled = true order by id
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_subscription (site_code, name, description, range_code, metrics, send_hour, receivers, enabled, ai_enabled, ai_model, snapshot_enabled, snapshot_query, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time) values (#{siteCode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{rangeCode}, #{metrics}, #{sendHour}, #{receivers}, #{enabled}, coalesce(#{aiEnabled}, false), #{aiModel}, coalesce(#{snapshotEnabled}, false), #{snapshotQuery}, #{createBy}, localtimestamp, #{createBy}, localtimestamp)
mapper.update: update dashboard_subscription set name = #{name}, description = #{description}, range_code = #{rangeCode}, metrics = #{metrics}, send_hour = #{sendHour}, receivers = #{receivers}, enabled = #{enabled}, ai_enabled = coalesce(#{aiEnabled}, false), ai_model = #{aiModel}, snapshot_enabled = coalesce(#{snapshotEnabled}, false), snapshot_query = #{snapshotQuery}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set enabled = #{enabled}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set del_flag = '2', enabled = false, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = localtimestamp where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0'
update dashboard_subscription set last_slot = #{slot} where id = #{id} and del_flag = '0' and enabled = true and (last_slot is null or last_slot <> #{slot})
mapper.insert: insert into dashboard_subscription_log (subscription_id, site_code, trigger_type, period, receiver_type, receiver_id, receiver_name, status, error, message_id, operator, create_time) values (#{subscriptionId}, #{siteCode}, #{triggerType}, #{period}, #{receiverType}, #{receiverId}, #{receiverName}, #{status}, #{error}, #{messageId}, #{operator}, localtimestamp)
